entries.subject: Archive access for a private telescope
entries.finding: A privately owned telescope with no archive: its images reach this repository by the owner's own publication and permission.
entries.revisitWhen: A body or star in this repository needs data from this facility.

entries.subject: Proprietary period, licence and credit
entries.finding: Each image is used on the terms its owner states; no archive policy applies.
entries.revisitWhen: This facility's data are used, or its terms are needed to publish a derived product.

entries.subject: Reduction software for this facility
entries.finding: No reduction software is run here; the owner delivers finished images.
entries.revisitWhen: Raw data from this facility are reduced here.
